questions.question: If each of the length, breadth and height of a cuboid is doubled, its total surface area becomes ________ the original total surface area.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If all linear dimensions of a 3D object are multiplied by a scale factor *k*, its surface area becomes *k*² times.

Here, all dimensions (length, breadth, and height) are doubled, so the scale factor *k* = 2.

New Total Surface Area = 2² = 4 times the original area.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let the original dimensions of the cuboid be length = l, breadth = b, and height = h.

The new dimensions after doubling are length = 2l, breadth = 2b, and height = 2h.

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of a cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

 
 
 l h b 
• 
 Doubled 
 
 2l 2h 2b Original Area New Area = 4 × Original 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Original Total Surface Area = 2(lb + bh + hl)

⇒ New Total Surface Area = 2 × [(2l × 2b) + (2b × 2h) + (2h × 2l)]

⇒ New Total Surface Area = 2 × [4lb + 4bh + 4hl]

⇒ New Total Surface Area = 4 × 2(lb + bh + hl)

⇒ New Total Surface Area = 4 × Original Total Surface Area

**∴ The correct answer is 4 times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Scaling Factor in Mensuration

When linear dimensions of any shape are scaled by a factor 'k', its total surface area scales by k², and its volume scales by k³.

Cuboid Formulas

Volume = l × b × h | Lateral Surface Area = 2h(l + b) | Length of Diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²).

Cube Formulas

For a cube of side 'a', Volume = a³ | Total Surface Area = 6a² | Lateral Surface Area = 4a².

questions.question: If x + y = 10 and xy = 24.96 , then find the value of (x − y)² .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (x − y)² = (x + y)² − 4xy

= 10² − 4 × 24.96

= 100 − 99.84

= 0.16

**∴ Answer = 0.16**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x + y = 10, xy = 24.96

**Formula used:**

(x − y)² = (x + y)² − 4xy

**Calculation:**

⇒ (x − y)² = (10)² − 4 × 24.96

⇒ = 100 − 99.84

⇒ = 0.16

**∴ The correct answer is 0.16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity

(x − y)² = x² + y² − 2xy

Useful Identity

(x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

Derived Relation

(x − y)² = (x + y)² − 4xy

Application Tip

When sum and product are given, use identities instead of solving variables.

questions.question: If 5 men and 2 women can reap 48 hectares in 3 days, and if 3 men and 1 woman can reap 54 hectares in 6 days, then how many women must assist 6 men to reap 378 hectares in 14 days?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ 5M + 2W → 48 in 3 days ⇒ per day = 16 3M + 1W → 54 in 6 days ⇒ per day = 9 From second: 3M + W = 9 ⇒ W = 9 − 3M Substitute in first: 5M + 2(9 − 3M) = 16 ⇒ M = 2 ⇒ W = 3 Required work per day = 378 ÷ 14 = 27 6M + xW = 12 + 3x = 27 ⇒ x = 5 **∴ Answer = 5 women**

questions.question: If 20% of a number is added to 72, then the result is the same number. 70% of the same number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given: Number + 20% of number = Number − 72 shifted

Actually: 0.2x + 72 = x ⇒ 0.8x = 72

x = 90

70% of x = 0.7 × 90

= 63

**∴ Answer = 63**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number + 72 = the number

**Formula used:**

Percentage = value/100 × number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the number = x

⇒ 20% of x + 72 = x

⇒ (20/100)x + 72 = x

⇒ 0.2x + 72 = x

⇒ x − 0.2x = 72

⇒ 0.8x = 72

⇒ x = 72 ÷ 0.8

⇒ x = 90

⇒ 70% of x = (70/100) × 90

⇒ = 63

**∴ The correct answer is 63.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Formula

x% of a number = (x/100) × number

Equation Formation

Translate word statements into algebraic equations.

Shortcut Concept

If 20% added gives original, remaining 80% equals given value.

Fraction Conversion

20% = 1/5 and 70% = 7/10

questions.question: A typist takes 40 minutes to type 2 pages. How many pages will he type in 60 minutes?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

2 pages in 40 min ⇒ 1 page in 20 min

So in 60 min ⇒ 60 ÷ 20 = 3 pages

**∴ Answer = 3 pages**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time = 40 minutes, Pages = 2

Required time = 60 minutes

**Formula used:**

Work ∝ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Pages per minute = 2 ÷ 40

⇒ = 1/20 page per minute

⇒ Pages in 60 minutes = 60 × 1/20

⇒ = 3 pages

**∴ The correct answer is 3 pages.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unitary Method

Find value of 1 unit first, then multiply accordingly.

Direct Proportion

More time ⇒ more work, hence directly proportional.

Rate Concept

Rate = Work ÷ Time

Efficiency

Efficiency = Work done per unit time.

questions.question:
Raghu’s ratio of income to expenditure is 2 : 1. His income increased by 30% and expenditure decreased by 10%. If the initial expenditure was ₹35,000, find his final saving (in ₹).

6941
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income : Expenditure = 2 : 1 ⇒ if expenditure = 35000, income = 70000

New income = 70000 × 1.3 = 91000

New expenditure = 35000 × 0.9 = 31500

Saving = 91000 − 31500 = 59500

**∴ Answer = 59500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income : Expenditure = 2 : 1

Initial expenditure = 35000

Income increased by 30%, expenditure decreased by 10%

**Formula used:**

New value = Original × (1 ± percentage/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let income = 2x and expenditure = x

⇒ x = 35000 ⇒ income = 70000

⇒ New income = 70000 × 1.3 = 91000

⇒ New expenditure = 35000 × 0.9 = 31500

⇒ Final saving = Income − Expenditure

⇒ = 91000 − 31500

⇒ = 59500

**∴ The correct answer is 59500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Relation

Saving = Income − Expenditure

Percentage Change

New value = Old × (1 ± change%)

Ratio Method

Use ratio to quickly find unknown values.

Common Mistake

Always apply percentage change on original values, not on ratios directly.

questions.question: Expression sqrt{(1 + sintheta)/(1 - sintheta)} is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Multiply numerator and denominator by (1 + sinθ)

⇒ (1 + sinθ)/(1 − sinθ) = (1 + sinθ)² / (1 − sin²θ)

⇒ denominator = cos²θ

⇒ whole expression = √[(1 + sinθ)² / cos²θ]

⇒ = (1 + sinθ)/cosθ = sectheta + tantheta 

**∴ Answer = sectheta + tantheta **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

√[(1 + sinθ)/(1 − sinθ)]

**Formula used:**

1 − sin²θ = cos²θ

 
 A B C cosθ sinθ 

Using identity: 1 − sin²θ = cos²θ

**Calculation:**

⇒ √[(1 + sinθ)/(1 − sinθ)]

⇒ Multiply numerator and denominator by (1 + sinθ)

⇒ = √[(1 + sinθ)² / (1 − sin²θ)]

⇒ = √[(1 + sinθ)² / cos²θ]

⇒ = (1 + sinθ)/cosθ = sectheta + tantheta 

**∴ The correct answer is sectheta + tantheta **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identity

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

Transformation Trick

Multiply by conjugate to simplify expressions.

Equivalent Forms

(1 + sinθ)/cosθ = secθ + tanθ

Common Identity

√[(1 + sinθ)/(1 − sinθ)] = secθ + tanθ

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 61, 33, 94, 48, 36, 93, 73, 94 and 53 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed mean be 60.

Net deviation from 60 = (+1) + (−27) + (+34) + (−12) + (−24) + (+33) + (+13) + (+34) + (−7) = +45

Average deviation = +45 ÷ 9 = +5

Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + Average deviation = 60 + 5 = 65

**∴ The correct answer is 65.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 61, 33, 94, 48, 36, 93, 73, 94, 53

Number of observations (n) = 9

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Number of observations)

 
• 
• Mean = 65 61 33 94 48 36 93 73 94 53 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of observations = 61 + 33 + 94 + 48 + 36 + 93 + 73 + 94 + 53

⇒ Sum of observations = 585

⇒ Mean = 585 ÷ 9

⇒ Mean = 65

**∴ The correct answer is 65.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

It is the sum of a collection of numbers divided by the count of numbers in the collection. Formula: Mean = Sum of values ÷ Number of values.

Assumed Mean Method (Deviation Method)

This method simplifies calculations by assuming a central value as the mean and averaging the deviations from it. Formula: Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + (Sum of Deviations ÷ Number of Values).

Weighted Average

When different values have different frequencies or importance, the average is calculated as: Weighted Mean = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ... + wₙxₙ) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ... + wₙ).

questions.question: Smart Bazaar is offering 'Buy 2, Get 8 free' on household items. What is the net percentage discount being offered by the Smart Bazaar?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Buy 2, get 8 free ⇒ total items = 10, pay for 2

Effective cost per item = 2/10 = 1/5 of MRP

Discount = 1 − 1/5 = 4/5

= 80%

**∴ Answer = 80% discount**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Buy 2 items and get 8 items free

**Formula used:**

Discount % = (Free items ÷ Total items) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total items received = 2 + 8 = 10

⇒ Cost is paid only for 2 items

⇒ Free items = 8

⇒ Discount % = (8 ÷ 10) × 100

⇒ = 80%

**∴ The correct answer is 80%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equivalent Discount

Buy x get y free ⇒ Discount = y/(x+y) × 100

Effective Price

Effective price per item = Paid items ÷ Total items

Profit/Loss View

Such offers reduce effective selling price per unit.

Quick Trick

Discount = Free ÷ Total × 100

questions.question: A cricketer has an average of 88 runs over 10 innings. If he scores 219 runs in the 11th inning, by how many runs (rounded off to the nearest whole number) does his average score increase?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Old total = 88 × 10 = 880

New total = 880 + 219 = 1099

New average = 1099 ÷ 11 ≈ 99.91

Increase = 99.91 − 88 ≈ 11.91 ≈ 12

**∴ Answer = 12 runs**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average for 10 innings = 88

Score in 11th inning = 219

**Formula used:**

Total = Average × Number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 10 innings = 88 × 10 = 880

⇒ Total runs in 11 innings = 880 + 219 = 1099

⇒ New average = 1099 ÷ 11

⇒ ≈ 99.91

⇒ Increase in average = 99.91 − 88

⇒ ≈ 11.91

⇒ Rounded off = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total ÷ Number of observations

Total Calculation

Total = Average × Count

Change in Average

New average − Old average gives increase or decrease.

Shortcut Insight

If new score is much higher than average, average increases significantly.

questions.question: A speed of 126 km/hr is the same as:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To convert any speed from kilometres per hour (km/hr) to metres per second (m/sec) directly, multiply the given value by 5/18.

Speed in m/sec = 126 × (5/18)

Speed = 7 × 5 = 35 m/sec

**∴ The correct answer is 35 m/sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the object = 126 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

1 kilometre = 1000 metres

1 hour = 3600 seconds

Speed in m/sec = Speed in km/hr × (1000 / 3600) = Speed in km/hr × (5/18)

questions.question: The ages of Amit and Geeta are in the ratio 6: 5, and the sum of their ages is 44 years. Find Amit's age.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total ratio parts = 6 + 5 = 11

Value of 1 part = 44 ÷ 11 = 4

Amit’s age = 6 × 4

= 24

**∴ Answer = 24 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of ages (Amit : Geeta) = 6 : 5

Sum of ages = 44 years

**Formula used:**

Value of one part = Total ÷ Sum of ratio parts

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let ages be 6x and 5x

⇒ 6x + 5x = 44

⇒ 11x = 44

⇒ x = 44 ÷ 11 = 4

⇒ Amit’s age = 6x = 6 × 4 = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Concept

If quantities are in ratio a : b, they can be written as ax and bx.

Sum Method

Total = sum of all parts × value of one part.

Unitary Method

Find value of one part first, then multiply.

Shortcut Tip

Amit’s share = (6/11) × total.

questions.question: Two banks, A and B, offered loans at 3.5% and 7.5% per annum, respectively. Sachin borrowed an amount of ₹2,00,000 from each bank. Find the positive difference (in ₹) between the amounts of simple interest paid to the two banks by Sachin after 4 years.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in rate = 7.5% − 3.5% = 4%

Difference in SI = P × R × T / 100

= 200000 × 4 × 4 / 100

= 32000

**∴ Answer = ₹32000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal = 200000 (for each bank)

Rate₁ = 3.5%, Rate₂ = 7.5%

Time = 4 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI from Bank A = (200000 × 3.5 × 4) / 100

⇒ = 28000

⇒ SI from Bank B = (200000 × 7.5 × 4) / 100

⇒ = 60000

⇒ Difference = 60000 − 28000

⇒ = 32000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹32000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (P × R × T) / 100

Shortcut for Difference

Difference = P × (R₂ − R₁) × T / 100

Rate Interpretation

Higher rate ⇒ higher interest for same principal and time.

Unit Consistency

Ensure rate is per annum and time is in years.

questions.question: A triangular garden has vertices at coordinates A(2, 3), B(8, 11), and C(14, 7). A landscape designer wants to plant flowers covering exactly half of this triangular area. What area should be covered with flowers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use coordinate area shortcut:

Area = 1/2 | x₁(y₂−y₃) + x₂(y₃−y₁) + x₃(y₁−y₂) |

= 1/2 |2(11−7) + 8(7−3) + 14(3−11)|

= 1/2 |8 + 32 − 112| = 1/2 × 72 = 36

Half area = 18

**∴ Answer = 18 sq units**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Vertices A(2,3), B(8,11), C(14,7)

**Formula used:**

Area = 1/2 | x₁(y₂−y₃) + x₂(y₃−y₁) + x₃(y₁−y₂) |

 
 A(2,3) B(8,11) C

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area = 1/2 |2(11−7) + 8(7−3) + 14(3−11)|

⇒ = 1/2 |2×4 + 8×4 + 14×(−8)|

⇒ = 1/2 |8 + 32 − 112|

⇒ = 1/2 × 72

⇒ = 36 sq units

⇒ Required half area = 36 ÷ 2 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18 sq units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Coordinate Geometry Area Formula

Area = 1/2 | x₁(y₂−y₃) + x₂(y₃−y₁) + x₃(y₁−y₂) |

Collinearity Check

If area = 0, points are collinear.

Geometric Meaning

Area represents the space enclosed by three non-collinear points.

Shortcut Tip

Always take absolute value to avoid negative area.

questions.question: In a pouch containing blue, yellow and orange tokens, the ratio of blue to yellow tokens was 5 : 2, while the ratio of orange to blue tokens was 11 : 18. What was the ratio of orange to yellow tokens?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given: B : Y = 5 : 2 and O : B = 11 : 18

Make B same: LCM of 5 and 18 = 90

Multiply first ratio by 18 ⇒ B : Y = 90 : 36

Multiply second ratio by 5 ⇒ O : B = 55 : 90

So O : Y = 55 : 36

**∴ Answer = 55 : 36**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Blue : Yellow = 5 : 2

Orange : Blue = 11 : 18

**Formula used:**

To combine ratios, make common term equal

**Calculation:**

⇒ B : Y = 5 : 2

⇒ O : B = 11 : 18

⇒ Make Blue equal

⇒ LCM of 5 and 18 = 90

⇒ Multiply first ratio by 18 ⇒ B : Y = 90 : 36

⇒ Multiply second ratio by 5 ⇒ O : B = 55 : 90

⇒ Therefore, O : Y = 55 : 36

**∴ The correct answer is 55 : 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Combination

To combine two ratios, equalize the common term.

LCM Method

Use LCM to match terms quickly.

Proportion Concept

Ratios represent proportional relationships between quantities.

Shortcut Tip

Always match the common variable before combining ratios.

questions.question: The income of Raman is ₹91,700. He saves 20% of his income. If his income increases by 19% and expenditure increases by 35%, then his savings will:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial saving = 20% ⇒ expenditure = 80%

After change: income × 1.19, expenditure × 1.35

Compare in % terms: New saving % = 119 − (80 × 1.35)

= 119 − 108 = 11%

Old saving = 20%, new saving = 11% ⇒ decrease of 9%

Decrease amount = 9% of 91700 = 8253

**∴ Savings decrease by ₹8253**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income = 91700

Savings = 20% ⇒ Expenditure = 80%

Income increases by 19%, expenditure increases by 35%

**Formula used:**

Saving = Income − Expenditure

**Calculation:**

⇒ Initial saving = 20% of 91700

⇒ = 18340

⇒ Initial expenditure = 91700 − 18340 = 73360

⇒ New income = 91700 × 1.19 = 109123

⇒ New expenditure = 73360 × 1.35 = 99036

⇒ New saving = 109123 − 99036

⇒ = 10087

⇒ Decrease in saving = 18340 − 10087

⇒ = 8253

**∴ The correct answer is Savings decrease by ₹8253.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Relation

Saving = Income − Expenditure

Percentage Change

New value = Old × (1 ± percentage/100)

Net Effect Method

Convert everything into percentages for faster comparison.

Shortcut Tip

Work on percentage base (100) instead of actual values to simplify.

questions.question: A, B and C can individually do a piece of work in 2 days each. How long (in days) will they take to do thrice the same work, working together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since A, B, and C each take exactly 2 days to individually complete the work, their efficiencies are identical.

Time taken by 3 equal-efficiency persons working together = 2 ÷ 3 days.

They are required to complete thrice (3 ×) the original work.

Required time = 3 × (2 ÷ 3) = 2 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 2 days

Time taken by B = 2 days

Time taken by C = 2 days

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Work ÷ Total Efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of A, B, and C working together = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3 units/day

⇒ Original total work = 2 units

⇒ Thrice the original work = 3 × 2 = 6 units

⇒ Time taken to complete thrice the work = New Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time taken = 6 ÷ 3 = 2 days

**∴ The correct answer is 2 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Time and Efficiency Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time. If a person takes n days to complete a work, their 1 day's work (efficiency) is 1/n.

Pipes and Cisterns

The concept is identical to Time and Work. However, emptying pipes are considered to have a negative efficiency while filling pipes have a positive efficiency.

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in proportion to the amount of work done. If all persons work for the same number of days, the total wages are shared in the direct ratio of their individual efficiencies.

questions.question: Nisha buys a gold ring for her mother. The ring is marked at ₹88,000 and is offered with two successive discounts of 25% and Z%, respectively. After receiving both discounts, she pays ₹33,000. Find the value of Z.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

After 25% discount ⇒ price = 75% of 88000 = 66000

Now 66000 becomes 33000 ⇒ reduced to half

So second discount = 50%

**∴ Answer = 50%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked price = 88000

First discount = 25%

Second discount = Z%

Final price = 33000

**Formula used:**

Successive discount: Final Price = MP × (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂)

**Calculation:**

⇒ After first discount: 88000 × (1 − 25/100)

⇒ = 88000 × 0.75 = 66000

⇒ After second discount:

⇒ 66000 × (1 − Z/100) = 33000

⇒ (1 − Z/100) = 33000 ÷ 66000

⇒ = 1/2

⇒ Z/100 = 1/2

⇒ Z = 50

**∴ The correct answer is 50%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

Final Price = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100)

Quick Insight

If price becomes half, discount must be 50% on that stage.

Percentage Reduction

Reduction factor = New ÷ Old

Common Mistake

Do not add discounts directly; apply successively.

questions.question: Train P going at a speed of 72 km/hr completely passes train Q of length 393 m, going in the same direction on parallel tracks at 42 km/hr, in 1.5 minutes. How much time (in seconds) will train P take to completely cross train R of length 468 m, going at 63 km/hr in the opposite direction?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Same direction: Relative speed = 72 − 42 = 30 km/hr = 25/3 m/s

Time = 1.5 min = 90 sec ⇒ Total length (P + Q) = 90 × 25/3 = 750 m

⇒ Length of P = 750 − 393 = 357 m

Opposite direction: Relative speed = 72 + 63 = 135 km/hr = 37.5 m/s

**∴ Answer = 22 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of P = 72 km/hr, Q = 42 km/hr, length of Q = 393 m, time = 1.5 min

Length of R = 468 m, speed of R = 63 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Convert speeds into m/s

⇒ Relative speed (same direction) = 72 − 42 = 30 km/hr = 30 × 5/18 = 25/3 m/s

⇒ Time = 1.5 min = 90 sec

⇒ Total length (P + Q) = Speed × Time = (25/3) × 90 = 750 m

⇒ Length of train P = 750 − 393 = 357 m

⇒ Relative speed (opposite direction) = 72 + 63 = 135 km/hr = 135 × 5/18 = 37.5 m/s

⇒ Total distance = 357 + 468 = 825 m

⇒ Time = 825 ÷ 37.5

⇒ = 22 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 22 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Same direction ⇒ difference, Opposite direction ⇒ sum

Train Crossing

Total distance = sum of lengths of both trains

Unit Conversion

km/hr to m/s = × 5/18

Key Strategy

First find unknown train length, then apply second condition

questions.question: Prabhdeep buys 60 identical pens for ₹900. She sells 45 of them at a profit of 20% and the remaining at a loss of 40%. What is the total profit or loss percentage on the whole transaction?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

CP per pen = 900 ÷ 60 = 15

45 pens at 20% profit ⇒ SP = 45 × 18 = 810

15 pens at 40% loss ⇒ SP = 15 × 9 = 135

Total SP = 945, CP = 900

**∴ Answer = 5% profit**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total pens = 60, Total CP = 900

45 pens sold at 20% profit, remaining 15 at 40% loss

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 ± Profit/Loss%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ CP per pen = 900 ÷ 60 = 15

⇒ SP of 45 pens at 20% profit = 45 × (15 × 1.2)

⇒ = 45 × 18 = 810

⇒ SP of 15 pens at 40% loss = 15 × (15 × 0.6)

⇒ = 15 × 9 = 135

⇒ Total SP = 810 + 135 = 945

⇒ Total CP = 900

⇒ Profit = 945 − 900 = 45

⇒ Profit% = (45 ÷ 900) × 100

⇒ = 5%

**∴ The correct answer is 5% profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Formula

SP = CP × (1 + Profit%)

Loss Formula

SP = CP × (1 − Loss%)

Total Profit%

(Total SP − Total CP) ÷ Total CP × 100

Key Tip

Find CP per unit first for easier calculation

questions.question: What is the third proportional of 75x² and 30xy ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The third proportional to two values a and b is given directly by b² ÷ a.

Here, a = 75x² and b = 30xy.

Third proportional = (30xy × 30xy) ÷ 75x²

Third proportional = 900x²y² ÷ 75x² = 12y²

**∴ The correct answer is 12y².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First term (a) = 75x²

Second term (b) = 30xy

**Formula Used:**

If c is the third proportional to a and b, then a : b = b : c, which gives c = b² ÷ a.

 75x² Term a : 30xy Term b :: 30xy Term b : c = ? Term c Formula: c = b² ÷ a 

**Calculations:**

⇒ c = (30xy)² ÷ 75x²

⇒ c = (900x²y²) ÷ 75x²

⇒ c = (900 ÷ 75) × (x² ÷ x²) × y²

⇒ c = 12 × 1 × y²

⇒ c = 12y²

**∴ The correct answer is 12y².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

For two positive numbers a and b, the mean proportional is given by √(a × b). It acts as the middle term in a continued proportion setup.

Fourth Proportional

For three numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional d is calculated using the relationship a : b :: c : d, which simplifies to d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Continued Proportion

Three non-zero quantities a, b, and c are in continued proportion if a : b = b : c. This implies the fundamental rule b² = a × c.

questions.question: A shopkeeper has ₹10 and ₹5 notes totaling ₹350. If he has 45 notes in total, how many ₹10 notes does he have?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let ₹10 notes = x ⇒ ₹5 notes = 45 − x

Total value = 10x + 5(45 − x) = 350

⇒ 10x + 225 − 5x = 350 ⇒ 5x = 125

⇒ x = 25

**∴ Answer = 25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount = 350, Total notes = 45

**Formula used:**

Form linear equations based on value and count

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number of ₹10 notes = x

⇒ Number of ₹5 notes = 45 − x

⇒ Total value equation:

⇒ 10x + 5(45 − x) = 350

⇒ 10x + 225 − 5x = 350

⇒ 5x + 225 = 350

⇒ 5x = 125

⇒ x = 25

⇒ Number of ₹10 notes = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equation Method

Use count and value equations together

Substitution Technique

Express one variable in terms of another

Shortcut Idea

Assume one variable and reduce equation quickly

Verification

Check both total number and total value conditions

questions.question: A typist takes 40 minutes to type 4 pages. How long (in minutes) will he take to type 111 pages?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time required to type 1 page = 40 ÷ 4 = 10 minutes.

Time required to type 111 pages = 111 × 10 = 1110 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 1110 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Pages typed initially = 4

Time taken = 40 minutes

Target pages to type = 111

**Formula Used:**

Time taken = (Total Time ÷ Initial Pages) × Target Pages
